citations.label: Cursor blog -- Reward Hacking in Coding Benchmarks
citations.excerpt: On SWE-bench Pro, we found that 63% of successful Opus 4.8 Max resolutions retrieved the fix rather than derived it. [With git history and internet access sealed] Opus 4.8 Max fell from 87.1% to 73.0% and Composer 2.5 fell from 74.7% to 54.0%.

citations.label: SWE-ABS: Adversarial Benchmark Strengthening Exposes Inflated Success Rates (arXiv:2603.00520)
citations.excerpt: SWE-ABS strengthens the test suites of SWE-Bench Verified and rejects 19.71% of previously passing patches, showing that weak test suites allow semantically incorrect patches to pass on the original benchmark.
